channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Massive water main break in Oakland County trapped drivers, prompts boil water advisory
item.description: Emergency responders had to rescue motorists after a water main break flooded streets on 14 Mile Road between Farmington and Drake roads early Saturday.

item.title: Two new trustees named to Oakland University board
item.description: Davis Boyd's 8-year term will commence on Aug. 12 and expire on Aug. 11, 2034.

item.title: Ex-sheriff’s investigator gets 36 years for recording teen girls with secret camera
item.description: A former Harford County Sheriff's deputy who used a secret camera to record two teen girls in a bedroom and bathroom was sentenced to federal prison. He is also charged in Carroll County with child pornography and sex abuse-related offenses.

item.title: No. 9 Iowa beats No. 8 Michigan 59-42, advances to Big Ten title game vs UCLA
item.description: Ava Heiden scored 16 points, Hannah Stuelke and Chazadi Wright each had 13, and No. 9 Iowa pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat No. 8 Michigan 59-42 on Saturday in the Big Ten Tournament semifinals.

item.title: Photo gallery from No. 1 Orchard Lake St. Mary’s vs. No. 2 Houghton in the D3 hockey state championship
item.description: Up 2-1 in the third period, it looked like Orchard Lake St. Mary's might pick up another D3 state title, but four straight Gremlin goals gave Houghton a 5-2 victory Saturday, March 7, 2026 in Plymouth.

item.title: St. Mary’s D3 title defense falls short to Houghton in state final
item.description: The top-ranked Orchard Lake St. Mary’s Eaglets led briefly in the final period before falling to the No. 2 Houghton Gremlins 5-2 in Saturday’s Division 3 championship at USA Hockey Arena.

item.title: CHEER FINALS ROUNDUP: Stoney Creek, Notre Dame Prep repeat as state champs
item.description: Welcome to the 3-peat club, Stoney Creek.

item.title: Photos of No. 1 Detroit Catholic Central vs. No. 5 Northville in a D1 hockey state championship
item.description: Top-ranked Detroit Catholic Central took home yet again another D1 state title by defeating No. 5 Northville 6-0 Saturday, March 7, 2026 at USA Hockey Arena in Plymouth.

item.title: ‘It doesn’t get old’: Detroit Catholic Central’s title-winning run continues as Shamrocks blank Northville in D1 final
item.description: The Detroit Catholic Central Shamrocks notched yet another state title Saturday night, defeating Northville 6-0 in the D1 final to claim their record seventh straight state championship.

item.title: Carter, Gregory, Lees lead Oakland County’s championship parade at D1 state finals
item.description: Nate Carter never got a chance to wrestle Rochester Adams’ Deacon Morgan this season even though the two compete in the same league – the Oakland Activities Association Red Division.
